mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its historical average compresses the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This is a direct monetary policy transmission channel.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 3.0%, the Federal Reserve is expected to tighten monetary policy, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1200 thousand units and industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 105, it signals a demand-supply imbalance that triggers inflationary expectations and monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST > 1200 and INDPRO < 105, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, a combination of low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) and strong monthly employment growth (PAYEMS growth > 100k) signals sustained economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS growth > 100k, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate relative to its long-term average reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days. This is a direct labor market channel to equity performance.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE is above 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1200 thousand units, it signals a weakening in the residential construction sector, reducing consumer confidence and business investment, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 1200, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle slowdown regimes, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105 indicates weakening manufacturing activity, which precedes a recession and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 105 and the regime is late-cycle slowdown, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is rising and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is falling, it signals a tightening monetary policy in a strong labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced liquidity and higher borrowing costs.
regime_hint: monetary tightening in strong labor market
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS increases > 0.1% and UNRATE decreases > 0.1%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
